assumptions: Tier-5 starting club, 2500 supporters, 20 players from the pinned world (key gameplay-balance-audit, seed 0); wages vary per club, the report keeps the min/max band and the full series of the first club.
Fixed seasonal sponsor: opening tenth-place base for cycles 1-18, renewal by final place/destination tier for cycles 19-20; the season prize lands with cycle 18 only, never earlier.
Expenses are charged before income each cycle; a negative pre-income minimum is a liquidity shortfall forecast, the runtime keeps cash >= 0 with debt instead.
Scout discoveries are private: declined/unsigned people never enter the public market and earn no resale income in this audit.
Development runs use train_player/develop_appearance/grant_growth directly; only the 18 official league appearances grant match growth, cup load days and friendlies grant none.
Training injuries are discarded to upper-bound growth; morale/ leadership/form draws stay seeded and deterministic.

ceiling_demo.note: Caps bind first: 20 strong sessions grant nothing when skills already sit at their potential.

development.recovery_note: Recovery is real elapsed hours (recovery-v1); adjacent UTC dates do not guarantee 24 hours of rest.

transfer_demo.note: A transfer reuses the same age-season budget object: prior use is preserved, and the grant is capped by the remaining allowance, not reset.

affordability.count_note: The turnover count exceeds the upfront-only count because season income (sponsor/merch/tickets/prize) funds part of the wages; both counts ignore windows and the 25-player cap.
affordability.squad_cap_note: Active+incoming player cap is 25 (application/candidates.py); a 20-player squad fits at most 5 signings without sales. Signings need an open window and a free slot; counts above ignore both and stay lower bounds.
affordability.upfront_cost_note: Mission + median signing at skill 5/4d is a LOWER BOUND: windows, squad cap and youth wages are ignored here.
